shared_rules.date_convention: UTC calendar date, identical to the frozen acquisition plan and census v0_1
shared_rules.grid_rule: native W10 native-UTM locked export grids; 10 m S2/S1 and 30 m Landsat never resampled to a common resolution inside a view
shared_rules.missingness: every view carries explicit per-band and per-date observation/VALID masks; absence is never encoded as a numeric value

status: FROZEN_BEFORE_TRAINING; data-semantics choices only; never tuned on model performance

companion_bands: valid_date_count (number of dates entering each pixel's median)
aggregation.no_medoid: medoid rejected at freeze time: it requires a distance choice that would encode a modeling decision; robust median needs none
aggregation.rule: per-pixel robust median across the available in-window dates, computed only over pixels VALID under the frozen per-sensor QA policy AND actually observed
aggregation.tie_break: even-count medians use the mean of the two central values; deterministic float32 reduction in fixed EARLY, MID, LATE order

MULTI_DATE_SEASONAL.definition: Fixed date-slot seasonal stack, one slot per tertile, with deterministic robust aggregation and full missingness propagation.

qa_components: per-date raw QA_PIXEL (kept, never summarized away)
landsat_seasonal_rule.sensor_identity: each slot records landsat5/7/8 identity; aggregation runs WITHIN sensor identity only; L7 and L8 pixels are never jointly medianed and no harmonization is applied

MULTI_DATE_SEASONAL.s1_seasonal_rule: S1 remains paired per optical event; no S1 temporal fusion across passes or dates; ASC/DESC never merged

sensitivity_tier.usage: frozen for later sensitivity analysis ONLY; never back-fills the primary view; threshold cannot be widened after seeing support without a new frozen contract

MULTI_DATE_SEASONAL.slot_assignment: each acquired V02_ELIGIBLE event occupies exactly its acquisition tertile slot; at most one S2 event and one Landsat observation per sensor per slot; max 3 S2 datatakes and 3 Landsat observations per cell-year; empty slots are explicit masks
stack_contents: per-slot SR bands in fixed band order
per-slot QA VALID mask (s2_scl_qa_v1_1 / Landsat VALID r2)
per-slot acquisition doy and event id
per-slot S1 pair block (VV/VH + pair gap + pass + orbit or missing-modality mask)

SINGLE_EVENT_CANONICAL.definition: Exactly one optical event per (cell, year); paired S1 optional but explicit.

landsat_rule.harmonization: NONE; no cross-sensor compositing or spectral adjustment
landsat_rule.scaling: C2 L2 scale 0.0000275 add -0.2 applied at export; recorded per product

SINGLE_EVENT_CANONICAL.optical_event_rule: first V02_ELIGIBLE S2 datatake in precedence MID > EARLY > LATE; cell-years with no eligible S2 event have NO canonical optical sample (never substituted from another year or sensor)

s1_pair_rule.missing_modality: when no <= 7 d gate-passing pair exists the S1 bands are emitted as an explicit missing-modality mask; the optical sample is preserved; the 14 d sensitivity tier is NOT used in this view

SINGLE_EVENT_CANONICAL.s2_qa_semantics: per-pixel VALID surface mask from the frozen s2_scl_qa_v1_1 SCL policy accompanies the SR bands; observed-mask gate and SCL VALID are both propagated
